annotations.target_phrase: Cowboys didn’t get into Simstim, he thought, because it was basically a meat toy.
annotations.annotation_text: The ideological hierarchy of console cowboys: rejecting simstim (broadcast sensory recording of other human bodies) as passive, vulgar entertainment ('meat toy') in favor of the disembodied mathematical purity of matrix navigation.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 60.
Hayles, N. Katherine. How We Became Posthuman. (1999).

annotations.target_phrase: Cyberspace slid into existence from the cardinal points.
annotations.annotation_text: The phenomenal experience of 'jacking in' through neural dermatrodes: an instantaneous displacement of physical somatic reality by the luminous Cartesian coordinates of the global matrix.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 60.

annotations.target_phrase: The abrupt jolt into other flesh. Matrix gone, a wave of sound and color...
annotations.annotation_text: Sensorium crossover: Case switching his deck link to Molly's simstim feed, experiencing her augmented biological body, pulse, eyesight, and environmental sensations in real time.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 60.
